none: PAS WAW-66B04B: Roman Samian Ware vessel (front, reverse and profile)
contea di ritrovamento: Warwickshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A fragment of the base of a Roman Samian Ware vessel, probably of East Gaulish manufacture dating to AD 175 - 225. The fragment consists of the base of a vessel, probably a bowl or dish. The base has a diameter of 77.23 mm. The broken remains of the vessel then extend from the base which has a width of 108.4 mm at the widest point.
